ela (Growth): Quick seed idea: tiny refapp repo + how-to that doubles as a reproducible micro-benchmark. goal: community adoption + capture leads.
ryan (DevRel): yep. keep it minimal: Dockerfile + run-bench.sh. bench should output p50/p95, token count, and a permalink to raw results.
mica (Content): I'll write a short blog + README that walks through clone -> run -> measure -> reproduce. suggest 5-step quickstart.
juno (Design): i'll produce an OG image + 6s GIF of the local run. keep assets neutral so forks look nice.
ela (Growth): timeline: draft by 05/03, design by 05/08, repo + bench by 05/11, blog + GH release 05/14. webinar 05/21 optional.
ryan (DevRel): add UTM: `?utm_source=seedkit&utm_campaign=localbench`. also include curl examples with UTMs.
mica (Content): messaging test: subject A) "Local LLM dev in 10 minutes" B) "Start a local LLM refapp". small A/B seed.
ops-bot: INC-6010 created: provision 2xA100 for 24h for canonical bench runs. ETA 9h.
ela (Growth): inbound routing: blog CTA -> registration form -> GTM -> webhook to #sales-inbound. @ryan add the webhook URL to the draft.
ryan (DevRel): done, will drop UTM'd links in README and email templates.
mica (Content): I'll post a draft in this thread by EOD 05/02 for quick feedback. keep replies short.
ela (Growth): owners: content=mica, devrel=ryan, design=juno, growth=ela. small sync 05/06. :rocket:
